Request a Callback Call 0330 174 4700 Service and Repair Garage Insurance for Garages, Workshops and MOT Testing Stations Running a service and repair garage comes with unique risks. From working on customer vehicles and operating specialist equipment to managing employees and meeting regulatory requirements, one unexpected incident can have significant financial consequences. At Kingfisher Insurance, we help garages, MOT stations and vehicle repair businesses arrange tailored motor trade insurance that is designed to protect their premises, people, equipment and reputation. Request a Callback Protecting Your Garage Business Whether you’re carrying out routine servicing, diagnostics, MOT testing, mechanical repairs or specialist vehicle work, your business faces a variety of exposures, including: Damage to customer vehicles Theft of tools, equipment or stock Employer and public liability claims Fire, flood or storm damage Defective workmanship claims Eqipment breakdown Loss of MOT licence Business interruption following an insured event. Our experienced motor trade insurance specialists will help identify the covers your business needs and tailor a solution around your operation and risks. What Does Service and Repair Garage Insurance Typically Cover? We understand that insurance requirements often vary between garages, but cover can typically include: Road Risks Insurance: Allows you and authorised employees to drive vehicles in connection with your business. Employers’ Liability Insurance: Protects your business against claims from employees injured or becoming ill through their work.
